description: The state of the dynamic DNS updater

ipv4.description: The public address of one family

address.description: The confirmed public address; null until one was found

service.description: The echo service that gave the address

checked_on.description: When the family was last checked, as an ISO time

error.description: Why the last check failed, in English; null when it worked

error_i18n.description: The translation key of the failure (`error.ddns-ip-failed`, `error.ddns-ip-disagree` or `error.ddns-ip-unconfirmed`)

ipv6.description: The public address of one family

address.description: The confirmed public address; null until one was found

service.description: The echo service that gave the address

checked_on.description: When the family was last checked, as an ISO time

error.description: Why the last check failed, in English; null when it worked

error_i18n.description: The translation key of the failure (`error.ddns-ip-failed`, `error.ddns-ip-disagree` or `error.ddns-ip-unconfirmed`)

next_run_on.description: When the next cycle runs, as an ISO time; null while the updater is not running

paused.description: True during a restore or a database move: Update now and Check now answer 409

running.description: True while a cycle is going on

records.description: The number of enabled records the user can see
